definitions: An idea, feeling, or opinion about something or someone, especially one formed without conscious thought or on the basis of little evidence.
An imitation of a voice, mannerism, or other characteristic of a person, especially as a form of entertainment.
A mark or design made by pressing something onto a surface.
The effect produced by something on the mind or senses.
examples: Her impression of the Prime Minister was spot on.
The fossil left a clear impression.
The book made a lasting impression on me.
